correctness.rationale: The exact geodesic/star-forest equivalence yields the core join of n discrete three-point columns and the explicit B_j pieces. Each B_j retracts to a filled triangle, each attaching intersection has nerve S^1, and pairwise overlaps of thick pieces lie entirely in A. The n>=3 core is simply connected, so iterative homotopy pushouts split off n two-spheres. Join orientation and relative sequences yield the integral representations. Independent finite full-face and mod-two rank checks n=2..5 and fifteen Lefschetz traces corroborated all tested instances; they are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete infinite-family GP complex has exact integral homotopy, with exponentially many top spheres, linearly many independent thick-column two-spheres, a sharp n=2 boundary and signed symmetry modules. The result extends known enumeration to structural topological information including inclusion maps and geometric sources of homology; it is not a mere count or renaming.
